markers: | summary = It allows spellcasters to summon a sphere of {{SmArea|fog}} on an area in range and heavily obscure the area. Creatures within the area are Blinded.

fields.Fog Cloud: Action, range 60 ft, 15 ft radius, lasts 10 turns. Fog heavily obscures the area and Blinds creatures within it. This specific item grant has no Concentration requirement.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
